title: The Whispering Woods
summary: Reznik navigates the dangerous Red Forest at dawn.

scenes.query: A wide shot of a dense, dead forest at dawn. The trees are twisted, their branches bare and unnatural. A thick, faintly glowing fog rolls across the ground.
A weathered stalker in a tactical SEVA suit walks cautiously into the frame from the left. He moves slowly through the dead forest, his rifle lowered but gripped tightly.
Close-up. A rusty car door lying on the ground suddenly floats upward, defying gravity. It spins lazily in mid-air before crashing violently back down into the dirt.
The stalker stops abruptly. He pulls a small metal bolt from a pouch on his belt and tosses it forward into the glowing fog. The bolt curves sharply mid-air and shoots straight up into the sky.
Close-up of the stalker's face through his visor. His tired grey-green eyes study the invisible anomaly. He gives a small, knowing nod to himself.
The Zone doesn't hunt you. It just waits for you to step wrong.
scenes.voiceover: The Zone doesn't hunt you. It just waits for you to step wrong.

scenes.query: The stalker adjusts his path, carefully stepping to the right to bypass the invisible trap. He walks deeper into the fog and fades into the twisted forest.
